learning_outcomes.title: Dilations and reflections of quadratics
learning_outcomes.statement: Write quadratics in vertex form and transform their graphs.
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: A negative outside coefficient reflects across the x-axis; |a|>1 stretches vertically. Simplify an inside coefficient before comparing.

questions.instruction: Describe the graph relative to the parent y=x².
questions.stem: Describe the graph relative to the parent y=x². g(x)=-\frac13x^2

options.text: Reflect across the x-axis; stretch by 4
Reflect across the x-axis; vertically compress by 1/3
Reflect across the y-axis; stretch by 4
Shift down 4 units

answer.correct_option_text: Reflect across the x-axis; vertically compress by 1/3

questions.instruction: Describe the graph relative to the parent y=x².
questions.stem: Describe the graph relative to the parent y=x². g(x)=(-\frac23x)^2

options.text: Vertical compression by 4/9; no reflection
Reflect across the x-axis; stretch by 9
Vertical stretch by 3
Shift left 3 units

answer.explanation: (−⅔x)²=(4/9)x²; squaring removes the sign. Equivalent horizontal stretch: 3/2.

questions.instruction: Describe the graph relative to the parent y=x².
questions.stem: Describe the graph relative to the parent y=x². g(x)=-2x^2

options.text: Reflect across the y-axis only
Compress vertically by 1/2
Shift down 2 units
Reflect across the x-axis; stretch vertically by 2

answer.correct_option_text: Reflect across the x-axis; stretch vertically by 2

questions.instruction: Describe the graph relative to the parent y=x².
questions.stem: Describe the graph relative to the parent y=x². h(x)=-7-x^2

options.text: Stretch by 7, then shift down 1
Reflect across the x-axis, then shift up 7
Reflect across the x-axis, then shift down 7
Reflect across the y-axis, then shift up 7

answer.correct_option_text: Reflect across the x-axis, then shift down 7
answer.explanation: The coefficient is −1 and the vertical shift is −7.

questions.instruction: Describe the graph relative to the parent y=x².
questions.stem: Describe the graph relative to the parent y=x². g(x)=2(x-3)^2+8

options.text: Reflect across the x-axis, then shift up 8
Stretch vertically by 2, shift right 3 and up 8
Stretch vertically by 3/2, then shift up 8
Compress vertically by 2/3, then shift down 8

answer.correct_option_text: Stretch vertically by 2, shift right 3 and up 8
answer.explanation: a=2, h=3 and k=8 in vertex form.

questions.instruction: Describe the graph relative to the parent y=x².
questions.stem: Describe the graph relative to the parent y=x². g(x)=-5-\frac43x^2

options.text: Reflect across the x-axis, stretch by 4/3, then shift down 5
Reflect and stretch by 4, then shift down 5
Compress by 1/4, then shift up 5
Shift left 5 and down 1/4

answer.correct_option_text: Reflect across the x-axis, stretch by 4/3, then shift down 5
answer.explanation: The coefficient is −4/3 and the vertical shift is −5.
